headline: Fuel: Cut of 17 Cents on Diesel Excise Extended Until September 5
summary: The Italian government extended a 17-cent-per-litre cut in diesel excise duties until September 5. About 130 million euros has been allocated to fund the measure during the summer travel period.
why: Excise duties form a large part of Italian fuel prices, so changes to them affect transport costs and consumer inflation.
